issue_title: tbx.ExpandRange drops numbers it should emit
issue_body: We use tbx.ExpandRange(s string) string to turn a compact range list into a full comma-separated list of numbers. Each item is either a single number or a low-high range, and ranges are inclusive on both ends. For example "1-3,5,7-8" should give "1,2,3,5,7,8" and "1-3,10-12" should give "1,2,3,10,11,12". Right now the top of each range is missing: "1-3" comes out as "1,2" instead of "1,2,3". Please make tbx.ExpandRange emit the full inclusive range.

expected_behavior: tbx.ExpandRange expands every item correctly: inclusive ranges emit both endpoints and single numbers survive.
